title: Mission Candidate
description: Machine-readable representation of a possible piece of work BEFORE an executable mission exists. Produced by mission formulation (human or future Director); consumed by the policy + ledger decision. Explicit facts and enums only — no LLM self-scoring fields (risk_score/confidence/importance) unless mechanically derived. A candidate may terminate as no_mission_warranted without ever opening a MissionContract; that is an expected healthy result.

problem_statement.description: Bounded statement of the possible work. Describes the question/discrepancy; does not prescribe a repair.

disposition.description: Current disposition. no_mission_warranted, wont_fix, duplicate, superseded and blocked are terminal non-mission outcomes; selected means a MissionContract may be opened.

mission_id.description: Mission id opened for this candidate, when disposition is selected and a MissionContract exists. Null/absent otherwise; no_mission_warranted MUST NOT carry a mission_id.

duplicate_of.description: Ledger item or mission this candidate duplicates, when disposition is duplicate.

superseded_by.description: Ledger item or mission that supersedes this candidate, when disposition is superseded.

overlap_refs.description: References to known overlapping work/PRs/issues that must be respected.

blocker_refs.description: References to known blockers (permissions, dependencies, unreachable evidence).

evidence.description: Observation references supporting the candidate. Facts, not self-scoring.

source.description: How the candidate entered the workflow.

signal_ref.description: Reference to one structured signal. signal_id is the immutable HQ-assigned identity assigned at first ingestion; source-native references are indexed and may gain evidence-backed aliases. v0.1 does not perform semantic rename detection.

signal_id.description: Immutable internal HQ signal identity. Never changes after first ingestion.

source_native_ref.description: Source-native reference (e.g. tests/foo.py::test_bar, CI job URL, issue number). Not assumed immutable; aliases capture renames.

aliases.description: Evidence-backed alternative source-native references for the same signal (e.g. after a test rename).
